## PR Summary

**Type:** (check one)
- [ ] `[Add]` New paper(s)
- [ ] `[Fix]` Correction / typo
- [ ] `[Refactor]` Structure / formatting
- [ ] `[Update]` Update existing entry

**Papers added / changed:**
- ModelName (Venue Year) → `papers/XX_category.md`

## Checklist

- [ ] Entry follows the format in [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Paper link is working and correct
- [ ] No duplicate — confirmed the paper is not already in the list
- [ ] Added to the correct category file
- [ ] One-sentence description is accurate
